messages:
viv: opened PR 9120 to fix a stale dashboard embed anchor, add trace-propagation examples (Node + Python) and a small migration note for a YAML key rename. tagging reviewers for a quick QA.

arpit: thanks! which anchor was stale? I can sweep links if you drop the path.

viv: the embed in docs/dashboards/rows previously pointed to /docs/dashboards#embed-rows-old. I updated it to /docs/dashboards#embed-rows and added a tiny example showing how to attach billing labels and trace ids so cost/latency rows map correctly. Also renamed the YAML key `billingLabels` -> `billing_labels` to match our snake_case convention; added a compat block.

sylvia: can you paste the snippets here? I'll run them in the examples runner.

viv: Node first:
```js
// Node (sdk >=0.7)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })

await client.attachTrace({
  trace_id: 'trace-2026',
  attrs: { route: '/v1/generate', model: 'r-x' },
  billing_labels: { team: 'payments', feature: 'invoice' },
  cost: { tokens: 12 }
})
// call client.generate(...) reusing the same trace context
```

viv: Python snippet:
```py
# Python (redwood==0.12)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))

c.attach_trace(trace_id='trace-2026', attrs={'route':'/v1/generate','model':'r-x'}, billing_labels={'team':'payments','feature':'invoice'}, cost={'tokens':12})
# subsequent c.generate(..., trace_context=c.current_trace())
```

jordan: quick nit: Node example uses billing_labels in the attachTrace call; older SDKs used `billingLabels`. Add a small "SDK compatibility" note above the snippets, otherwise folk copy/paste and hit runtime errors. Also add an alt text for the dashboard screenshot.

viv: will add. I'll add: "SDK note: v0.7+ uses billing_labels; older clients accept billingLabels but it's deprecated."

docs-bot: link-checker: removed broken anchor /docs/dashboards#embed-rows-old -> replaced with /docs/dashboards#embed-rows. Please verify anchor exists and update permalinks.

arpit: I validated the new anchor; it exists. For the YAML migration block, suggest showing both keys like:
```yaml
# canonical (new)
billing_labels: { team: payments }
# legacy (still accepted but deprecated)
billingLabels: { team: payments }
```

sylvia: ran both snippets in the runner. Python were fine after adding `os` import in the snippet (I patched locally). Node needed a small change: attachTrace async/await context requires top-level async. I updated the snippet with an IIFE in my local patch and it'll be in the PR. Also uploaded the dashboard image to assets and added descriptive alt text: "Dashboard rows showing cost attribution grouped by billing labels (team: payments)".

jordan: can we add a tiny docs-ci smoke job that parses the YAML example so we catch camelCase regressions? Non-blocking on first rollout but good to have.

viv: sounds good. I'll create a follow-up PR to add the yaml-parse job and reference it in the PR description. For this PR I'll include a note in the description: `ci: TODO add yaml-parse job` so it shows up in the changelog.

arpit: nit on wording in the migration FAQ: instead of "will old embeds break?" use "Do I need to update my embedded dashboards?" and include the answer: "No immediate break, server accepts legacy keys but logs deprecation warnings; update to snake_case to avoid future issues."

viv: updated the FAQ text in the PR. Also added the SDK compatibility note and the alt text. Assigning reviewers: arpit, sylvia, jordan. Targeting merge after CI green.

docs-bot: ci: link-check passed; docs-lint passed on branch. waiting for examples-runner smoke check.

sylvia: smoke runner completed locally: Node snippet rendered in the live example, YAML parses, images load. One tiny change: replace `billing_labels` example key order with stable ordering to avoid flakey tests. I pushed that single-line change.

jordan: approved. nothing else from security or accessibility.

arpit: approved pending CI.

viv: merging after green. I'll follow up with a short changelog entry `migration: embed-anchor + billing_labels` and ping platform teams. thanks everyone!
